topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines how the lecture will integrate previously learned immune components to explain the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate recognition of pathogens and cellular damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the molecular mechanisms by which innate immune receptors identify microbial patterns and cellular injury to trigger inflammatory signaling.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment and inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells coordinate the mobilization and trafficking of immune cells to inflamed tissues and the physiological consequences of inflammatory activation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory responses are brought to a conclusion and how tissues either heal or transition into persistent inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on the complement system.
